entries.name: OpenCut Classic timeline math
modifications: Replaced OpenCut WASM tick constants with an explicit Sanverse timescale parameter.
Removed browser-global and device-pixel helpers not needed by the bounded spike.
Capped the spike zoom range and retained only scale, tick-to-pixel, fit, and exponential slider behavior.
entries.reason: Measure whether pure OpenCut timeline math can sit behind a one-way Sanverse adapter without importing OpenCut authority.
entries.upgradePolicy: No automatic upgrades. Re-audit the exact upstream commit before any production port.
entries.reviewPolicy: Review license, provenance, adaptation diff, and Sanverse authority before production use.
